006package dev.metaschema.databind.model.metaschema;
007
008import java.util.List;
009
010import dev.metaschema.core.model.IBoundObject;
011import dev.metaschema.core.util.CollectionUtil;
012import dev.metaschema.databind.model.metaschema.binding.ConstraintLetExpression;
013import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
014
015/**
016 * Base interface for value-level constraint bindings.
017 * <p>
018 * This interface provides access to constraints that apply to flag and field
019 * values.
020 */
021public interface IValueConstraintsBase extends IBoundObject {
022  /**
023   * Get the let expressions defined for this constraint set.
024   *
025   * <p>
026   * The default implementation returns an empty list. Implementations with let
027   * expressions should override this method.
028   *
029   * @return the list of let expressions, or an empty list if none are defined
030   */
031  @NonNull
032  default List<ConstraintLetExpression> getLets() {
033    return CollectionUtil.emptyList();
034  }
035
036  /**
037   * Get the constraint rules defined for this constraint set.
038   *
039   * @return the list of constraint rules
040   */
041  List<? extends IConstraintBase> getRules();
042}
